senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. מָשַׁח II)to draw, pull; to seize; (with מן) to withdraw; in gen. to stretch, produce a continuous line or flow; to conduct.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 8:2">Kil. VIII, 2</cite> <he>לחרוש לִמְשׁוֹךְ ולהנהיג</he> to plough with, to pull (by the head, go in front of), and to drive.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 86:2">Gen. R. s. 86</cite> <he>שהיו מוֹשְׁכִין וכ׳</he>, v. infra. Mekh. Bo, s. 11 (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 12:21">Ex. XII, 21</cite>) <he>מִשְׁכוּ מי שיש לו וכ׳</he> ‘lead forth’ (select), refers to him who has a lamb, ‘and buy’, refers to one who has none.
<cite ref="Exodus 12:21">Ib.</cite> <he>מִשְׁכוּ מע״ז</he> withdraw from idolatry.

<cite ref="Exodus 12:21">Ib.</cite> <he>שמוֹשְׁכִין את ידיהם ממנו וכ׳</he> that you may withdraw your share in the Passover lamb as long as it has not been slaughtered (v. <cite ref="M01772"><he>מָנָה</he></cite>); <cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 8:3">Pes. VIII, 3</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 9:10">Ib. IX, 10</cite> <he>אלו מושכין להן אחד וכ׳</he> the one company select one lamb, the other &c.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 1:3">M. Kat. I, 3</cite> <he>מוֹשְׁכִים את המים וכ׳</he> you may draw (conduct) the water in channels from tree to tree.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 26:1">Pesik. R. s. 26</cite> <he>שמא יִמְשׁוֹךְ לו חלב והוא אינו מוֹשֵׁךְ</he> perhaps it (the breast) will yield him milk when sucking, but it did not yield.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 52:3">Ex. R. s. 52</cite> <he>התחילה מוֹשֶׁכֶת דינרי וכ׳</he> it (the valley) began to give forth a flow of gold denars before their eyes.
<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 14:8">Tosef. Sot. XIV, 8</cite>; <cite ref="Sotah 47b:19">Sot. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>מוֹשְׁכֵי הרוק</he> those who draw out their spittle (assume aristocratic airs).

<cite ref="Chagigah 14a:10">Ḥag. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>מושכין לבו וכ׳</he> they draw the heart of the people as one conducts water, when they lecture; <cite ref="Shabbat 87a:8">Sabb. 87ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>ויגד</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 19:9">Ex. XIX, 9</cite>, v. <cite ref="N00117"><he>נָגַד</he></cite>) <he>דברים שמושכין … כאגדה</he> words which draw (attract) the heart of man like a lecture.
Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42ᶜ top מָשְׁכוּ צינורות דם וכ׳ the gutters of Laodicea carried a flow of blood; a. v. fr.—Esp. (law) to take possession by drawing or seizing an object, v. מְשִׁיכָה.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 4:2">B. Mets. IV, 2</cite> <he>מ׳ הימנו פירות וכ׳</he> if he took possession of fruits bought of him before paying.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 47a:5">Ib. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>לא הספיק לִמְשׁוֹךְ וכ׳</he> he had not yet had time to take possession of the ass; a. v. fr.—

Zeb. 6ᵇ סכין מוֹשְׁכַתָּן למה שהן the slaughtering knife takes possession of them for what they are to be, i.e. the slaughtering of the sacrifices decides their purpose; Shebu. 12ᵇ.—מ׳ ערלה to stretch the prepuce, to disguise circumcision.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:54">Y. Peah I, 16ᵇ</cite>; a. e.—Part. pass. <cite ref="M02828"><he>מָשׁוּךְ</he></cite>; f. <cite ref="M02829"><he>מְשׁוּכָה</he></cite>; pl. <he>מְשׁוּכִים</he>, <he>מְשׁוּכִין</he>; <he>מְשׁוּכוֹת</he>
<cite ref="Niddah 57b:4">Nidd. 57ᵇ</cite> <he>אם מ׳</he> if the blood-stain has the shape of a line, opp. <he>עגול</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 1:6:3">Y. Erub. I, 19ᵇ</cite> top <he>היה מ׳</he> if the wall is straight-lined.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 1:6:3">Ib.</cite> <he>שלא תהא הקורה מ׳ וכ׳</he> that the beam be not prolonged more than &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 1:6:3">Ib.</cite> <he>במשוכין יותר וכ׳</he> when they are longer than &c.; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 5:3">Mikv. V, 3</cite>, v. <cite ref="N00229"><he>נָדָל</he></cite>.—
senses.label: a

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 9:10">Pes. IX, 10</cite> <he>ידיך מ׳ משלך וכ׳</he> thy share be withdrawn from thy lamb, and be transferred to ours; a. e.—
senses.label: b

senses.gloss: to be stretched. Y. Yeb. VIII, 8ᵈ bot. נִמְשְׁכָה מאליה if the prepuce overgrew the corona of itself, v. מָשׁוּךְ.

units: <cite ref="Horayot 12a:9">Hor. 12ᵃ</cite>. <he>אין מושחין … כדי שׁתִּמָּשֵׁךְ מלכותן</he> kings are anointed at a spring in order that their government may be prolonged (cmp. Ḥag. l. c.). Ib. <he>נמשכה מלכותן</he> their dynasty was prolonged; a. fr.
<cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 7:7">Tosef. Pes. VII, 7</cite> <he>רצו להִמָּשֵׁךְ ולהמנות וכ׳</he> (ed. Zuck. incorrect) if they desire to withdraw, and that others be entered &c.
<cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 7:7">Ib.</cite> <he>נִמְשָׁכִין והולכין וכ׳</he> they may go on withdrawing &c., a. fr.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 24">Ex. R. s. 24</cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 86">Gen. R. s. 86</cite> <he>לפרה שהיו מושכין … ולא היתה נִמְשֶׁכֶת</he> like a cow which they attempt to pull to the slaughter-house, and which will not go; a. fr.
<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 9:5">Tosef. Par. IX (VIII), 9</cite> <he>המים הנִמְשָׁכִין וכ׳</he> well-water derived into a channel &c., v. <cite ref="M02753"><he>מָרַץ</he></cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Ketubot 10b">Keth. 10ᵇ</cite> (the rain) <he>מצדן ומַמְשִׁיךְ</he> gives beauty and enlargement (to the fruits).

senses.gloss: to draw, pull. Y. Kil. VIII, 31ᶜ top, a. e. הנהיגה הִמְשִׁיכָהּ וכ׳ if he drove the animal, or pulled it, or called it.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 20">Ex. R. s. 20</cite>, beg. <he>הִמְשַׁכְתִּיו ברסן</he> I pulled him by the bridle; a. e.

<cite ref="Temurah 12b:4">Tem. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>שאובה שהִמְשִׁיכוּהָ כולה</he> a collection of drawn water all of which has been conducted through a channel. Y. Shebi. II, end, 34ᵇ <he>להַמְשִׁיךְ</he> to irrigate by gutters, contrad. to <he>להשקות</he>. Y. M. Kat. I, 80ᵇ top <he>ה׳ המעיין וכ׳</he> he led the water of a well into it.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 7:16">Tosef. Sabb. VII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 8:16">VIII</cite>), 16 <he>מַמְשִׁיכִין יין וכ׳</he> you may let wine or oil run in gutters before bride and groom; <cite ref="Berakhot 50b">Ber. 50ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to prolong a meal, to add a course.
units: <cite ref="Sukkah 27a">Succ. 27ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="Q01967"><he>פַּרְפֶּרֶת</he></cite>.
